entries.summary: Introduced governance/change_log.json as a passive, non-enforcing per-repo change tracker (federation-wide rollout across all seven repos). It documents changes only; nothing reads or validates it, and nothing in CI depends on its contents. Prompted by removing a repo-wide change-freeze that existed in moneysweep-pr and ovnis-pr's unified-skillpack conformance checks and blocked ordinary PRs; this repo never had that freeze.

Adopted the change-coupled documentation gate defined by thehub-pr ADR 0010: the shared tools/check_docs_sync.py, a docs-sync workflow, a Claude Code Stop hook, CLAUDE.md, and this repo's .federation/docs-sync.json. Re-pinned PRII_TEMPLATE_REF to thehub-pr 09e2e54, which carries the checker's fix for path:symbol references and the prii-desktop pin bump in requirements-desktop.txt (a desktop startup failure now shows an error screen instead of hanging Setup). Corrected the README sentence saying validate.yml does not gate on ruff (its lint job does run it). Tooling and workflow change plus that pin bump: no contract, schema or dependency edge changed. PROVISIONAL until docs-sync is a required status check on main.

Re-pinned PRII_TEMPLATE_REF to thehub-pr 4258c3c, which hardens the shared docs-sync checker (thehub-pr#359): a pull request can no longer exempt itself through exempt_authors, manifest hygiene is judged on the head manifest so retiring a coupling or renaming a coupled doc no longer fails, a glob that matches nothing now fails when the change adds it, and a :symbol or :line locator is dropped from Markdown link targets. CONTRIBUTING.md now states what the gate enforces. The manifest comment now says a coupling fires on its on events. Tooling and documentation change only: no contract, schema or dependency edge changed.

The four workflows that commit straight to main (el-yunque-access-monitor, handoff-ack, just-security-monitor, signal-ledger-refresh) now check out with secrets.CENTINELAS_BOT_TOKEN, falling back to the Actions token. Since 2026-10-20 main requires docs-sync, which a push from the Actions token can never satisfy, so their pushes were rejected (handoff-ack failed in every run; el-yunque-access-monitor hid the rejection behind `|| echo`, which is removed). A token owned by a repository administrator is covered by the ruleset's admin bypass. The runtime effect needs the secret to be created; README notes it. No dependency, contract or schema change.
